subject: Goosefish
topic: Can you spot the fish? It's lying right there on the seafloor, six hundred meters down.
script:
Can you spot the fish? It's lying right there on the seafloor, six hundred meters down.
It's a goosefish, also called a monkfish.
Its flat, mottled body blends almost perfectly into the mud.
Goosefish are anglerfish. A spine on top of the head works like a fishing rod with a lure.
When prey comes close, that enormous mouth opens in a flash.
It can swallow prey almost as big as itself.
Goosefish have even been found with seabirds in their stomachs.
In the Gulf of Mexico, another one turned to take a good look at the robot before swimming away.
Would you have spotted it in time?
pkg_title: This Fish Hides in the Mud and Swallows Prey WHOLE 😳 #Shorts
